meta.title: Duplicate question ids
meta.task: Reject two questions that share an id

questions.question: What should the skill be called?

options.label: ballot
options.tradeoff: Short and already the vocabulary in spec, but overloads an existing term.

options.label: decision-board
options.tradeoff: Unambiguous, but longer to type and disconnected from the spec wording.

questions.question: Does the board need a confirmation step before answers are written?

options.label: Confirm before writing
options.tradeoff: Catches misclicks, but adds a step to every single pass.

options.label: Write immediately
options.tradeoff: Fastest path, but a stray click silently records a decision.
